claims.quote: A change to facts is followed through a relation that rules invent rows of when it has a key or other rules beside them, and through one whose unknowns an equality rule makes one, a component of values at a time: the values the changed rows hold, and every value a row joins to them, are derived again on their own, and the rest keeps its rows. Where a key makes twins share an invented mother, adding twenty twins one at a time and asking each one's mother takes 17 milliseconds with 10,000 people, where it took 8.4 seconds, and 0.1 seconds with 100,000, where it did not finish in a minute. It applies when every relation goal of the rules holds only variables and values, the goals of each rule share variables, and nothing else in their bodies asks a question; such a group whose rules join rows some other way is still derived again and compared.
